display.purpose: Page titles only. One per page.

body.purpose: Running text. Capped at 72ch in prose surfaces.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default card resting state. Hairline ring plus ambient diffusion.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus ring on interactive primitives.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Reserved; use sparingly for affirmation moments only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive primary action. One per surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #3b51d4; color: #fafafa; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.55 0.22 265 / 0.88); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.22 265 / 0.25); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Inline secondary action next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid #e3e3eb; border-radius: 10px; background: #fcfcfd; color: #1a1c26; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f3f3f7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.22 265 / 0.15); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet inline action. Used for back nav, dropdown triggers, row actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #1a1c26; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f3f3f7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.22 265 / 0.15); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default resting card surface. Static unless wrapped in an interactive element.
components.html:
Recording Info
Duration 32 min. 3 speakers. Status ready.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; background: #ffffff; color: #1a1c26; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; color: #1a1c26; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field. Border + xs shadow at rest, indigo glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e3e3eb; border-radius: 10px; background: #fcfcfd; color: #1a1c26; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(106, 109, 126, 0.6); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #3b51d4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.22 265 / 0.15); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status pill. Pairs with text always; never icon-only.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #e3e3eb; border-radius: 999px; background: #fcfcfd; color: #1a1c26; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.005em; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Single sidebar row. Icon + label. Active state is a soft tinted background, never a stripe.

narrative.overview:
Allure AI is a working surface for engineering and product teams to turn raw meeting audio into trustworthy artifacts. The interface is infrastructure: it carries the content (transcripts, outcomes, tasks, PRDs) without competing with it. Chrome recedes. The single indigo accent does one job, signal, and it does that job rarely. Everything else is a tinted neutral.

The system is built around restraint. Density flexes with purpose: dense for transcript lists and task tables; airy for PRDs and single-recording reviews. Motion is honest, an ease-out decay that confirms a state change happened, never choreography that asks for attention. Cards exist where containment is structural, never as decoration; nothing is wrapped in a card because "a card looked nice."

What this system explicitly rejects: purple-mesh gradient heroes, sparkle iconography, gradient-clipped headings, ChatGPT-clone chat shells, Jira-style toolbars, boxy enterprise chrome, hero-metric SaaS templates.
keyCharacteristics: Content is the hero; chrome is supporting cast.
Indigo is rare, intentional, and singular in role.
Type carries hierarchy more than color or size variance does.
Spacing scales with viewport via clamp(); density varies by surface, not by mood.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo is used on no more than 10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes it readable as signal. If two indigo elements are competing for attention on the same surface, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff, with the single exception of card (the sheet-on-paper metaphor). Every other neutral carries chroma 0.005-0.01 toward hue 265.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Text Rule
rules.body: Color is never the only signal for state. A red badge always pairs with text or icon; an indigo selection always pairs with a position or label.

rules.name: The 72ch Rule
rules.body: Prose surfaces (PRD body, generated documents) cap at 72ch and center. Wide monitors get margin, not stretched text.

rules.name: The Heading-Carries-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from family + weight contrast, not color shifts. Headings stay foreground; section heads stay foreground; titles stay foreground. Indigo never colors a heading.

rules.name: The No-Uppercase-Labels Rule
rules.body: Labels read as plain prose-cased text. No text-transform: uppercase on UI copy. Uppercase belongs to print, not operations tooling.

rules.name: The Hairline-Plus-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards always carry both a low-contrast hairline ring and a soft ambient shadow. Either alone reads as cheap; together they read as real paper on the field.

rules.name: The No-Decorative-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist to communicate elevation or focus. A shadow on a hero block, on a section background, or on text is wrong.

dos: Do use Signal Indigo only for primary action, current selection, focus, and live data. If you can replace it with foreground, do.
Do cap prose surfaces at 72ch and center them. Wide monitors get margin, not stretched text.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 265 (chroma 0.005-0.01). No flat grays.
Do pair status colors with text and icons. Color alone is never the signal.
Do use the --shadow-card + --shadow-card-hover pair as a single unit. Interactive cards lift 1px on hover; static cards stay put.
Do vary spacing for rhythm. Tight inside groupings (8-16px), generous between sections (32-48px).
Do keep page headers (h1 + subtitle) tightly stacked above the first content block.
Do match Space Grotesk weights 600-700 to headings only; never use it for body.
donts: Don't ship purple-mesh gradient heroes, animated blobs, or sparkle iconography. These read as generic AI SaaS, the exact aesthetic this product rejects.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Headings stay solid foreground.
Don't apply glassmorphism (backdrop-blur) as a default surface. It belongs to dialogs over media at most.

Don't template hero-metric blocks (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent). The dashboard's stat row shows real data and reads as the operations summary; never decorate fake numbers.
Don't wrap everything in a card. Most things, page titles, subtitles, inline lists, do not need containment.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Use spacing and a hairline.
Don't use side-stripe borders (colored border-left accents on rows or callouts). Replace with a full border, a tinted background, or nothing.
Don't decorate with shadow. Shadows mean elevation or focus, nothing else.
Don't lean on Jira-style dense toolbars or boxy enterprise chrome. The product is calm and reduced; chrome recedes.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't uppercase UI labels. Plain prose-case throughout.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left). Animate transform and opacity only.
Don't introduce a second accent color. Allure has one voice, and it's indigo.
